candidates.title: PointCast: One World Model for Rigid, Articulated, and Deformable Object Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Topology-agnostic point-set dynamics spans rigid, articulated, cloth, and rope manipulation with MPC evidence.

candidates.title: AgriGen: Large-Scale Scene Generation Framework for Photorealistic Agricultural Robotics Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: ROS/Isaac-Sim procedural worlds with physics, domain randomization, and inspectable scene samples.

candidates.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
candidates.why_candidate: Targets counterfactual action separability for closed-loop world-model planning.

candidates.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
candidates.why_candidate: Uses rollout context to adapt VLA behavior under hardware shifts.

candidates.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
candidates.why_candidate: Rolling joint denoising improves replanning speed with code and G1 results.

candidates.title: Streaming-WAM: Action-Conditioned World-Action Model for Asynchronous Robot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Conditions predictions on committed actions for continuous asynchronous WAM execution.

candidates.title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
candidates.why_candidate: Open physical world model couples asynchronous visual prediction, actions, force, and touch across 7,233.5 hours.

candidates.title: EmbodiedMemory-Bench: Benchmarking Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
candidates.why_candidate: 2,554 executable episodes isolate four memory capabilities and ship data plus interfaces.

candidates.title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Releases 150 task generators, 1.5M samples, exam, weights, and training stack.

candidates.title: RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World?
candidates.why_candidate: Varies 13 physical attributes and provides 5,000+ demonstrations for physics robustness.

candidates.title: Fysiverse-3D-Vision Technical Report: Generating Executable 3D Worlds from Images through Unified Spatial Reasoning
candidates.why_candidate: Promising executable 3D generation, but no official project/demo/code surface was found.

candidates.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
candidates.why_candidate: Action rehearsal is relevant, but the work-in-progress release lacks an official demo surface.

candidates.title: Ego-Exo4D Human Meshes Dataset: 4D Human Motion Reconstruction for Ego-Exo Captures
candidates.why_candidate: Useful 4D human-motion infrastructure but indirect for target tasks.
